fields.name: ConsoleVersions
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xBE0E10 ecl::mod::ValidationSystem::ValidatePublishInfo gets this singleton (getter EoCClient.dll+0xBDD0F0, its error path names GetTypeName<ecl::mod::ConsolesInfoSingletonComponent>) and calls the map's get-or-insert FUN_1804BA830(component, &uint64 mod id): on a successful UGC request it stores an 8-byte value from the publish info (+0x98) at value+0 and sets value+8 = 1 (has-value), otherwise it clears value+8 - an Optional<8-byte> value. GatherConsoleRequests (EoCClient.dll+0xBDF910) looks uint64 mod ids up in the component's key HashSet (bucket count at +8) next to a HashMap<uint64, ls::Optional<ls::Version>> argument - same value type. macOS default: four zeroed 16-byte blocks; live (idle): empty map.

open_questions: Key is the published (UGC) mod id; whether the stored Version is the console build of the mod is inferred from the component name.
status_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
hold: uses types declared elsewhere (Version, optional): Script Extender's own headers or another layout; whether they are declared before this one is not checked yet
